```{r}
#| include: false
root <- normalizePath(here::here())
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) {
  Site <- .reportLabel()
  Site <- if (nzchar(Site)) {
    sprintf(" for %s", Site)
  } else if (exists("params", inherits = FALSE) && !is.null(params$site)) {
    sprintf(" for %s", params$site)
  } else {
    ""
  }
  CAP <- paste0(
    "Selected ground motions", Site,
    ". Mw = moment magnitude; Repi = epicentral distance; PGA = peak ground ",
    "acceleration; AI = Arias intensity; CAV = cumulative absolute velocity; ",
    "CAV5 = thresholded cumulative absolute velocity; SF = c_i, the ",
    "suite-level record-scale coefficient applied after modal reconstruction ",
    "and energy normalization, not the total amplitude change from the ",
    "original recording. Intensity measures are reported for the final ",
    "matched H1 component."
  )
  rm(Site)
}
if (!exists("PathSRS", inherits = FALSE)) {
  if (exists("SRS.target", inherits = FALSE)) {
    PathSRS <- file.path(root, "gmsp", "match", SRS.target)
  } else {
    SRS_ROOT <- file.path(root, "gmsp", "match")
    SRS_RUNS <- list.dirs(SRS_ROOT, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)
    if (length(SRS_RUNS) != 1L) {
      stop("SRS table: set SRS.target or PathSRS before including _tbl/SRS.qmd.", call. = FALSE)
    }
    PathSRS <- SRS_RUNS[[1L]]
    SRS.target <- basename(PathSRS)
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-srs-records
#| tbl-cap: !expr CAP
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "tbl", "SRS.R"))
TBL
```

```{r}
#| include: false
rm(list = intersect(c(
  "PathSRS", "SRS.target", "SRS_ROOT", "SRS_RUNS", "CAP", "N",
  "SRS_SITE_TEXT"
), ls()))
```
